cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Keep the Peace
cards.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave that letter under my plate. I've approved breakfast together, and we're finally managing one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Has your brother canceled paying us back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This month's rent is covered. Discussion of another suitcase in the hall is not on today's menu.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then may I open the letter?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not yet. Yesterday you finally unpacked. I'm insisting on one whole breakfast with you before I risk a conversation that sends you packing again.

reason: A controls permission to inspect the letter and the conversation scope, hiding the truth out of an explicit fear that fragile reconciliation cannot survive it.
